newsitem.title: USA: Grow Biz to buy Ohio used games exchange.
newsitem.headline: Grow Biz to buy Ohio used games exchange.

text.p: Grow Biz International Inc said Wednesday it agreed to purchase certain assets and franchising rights from Video Game Exchange, based in Cleveland, Ohio.

Video Game Exchange operates 40 retail stores in Ohio, Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Georgia and Maryland that buy, sell and trade used video games and equipment. Video Game Exchange is privately held and has $17 million in annual revenues.
The letter of intent requires negotiation of a definitive purchase agreement. Terms were not disclosed.

Grow Biz President Ronald Olson said this potential acquisition, will form "the nucleus of our sixth business concept. We plan to franchise stores selling video games, computer games, comics, trading cards, Japan-a-mation videos, strategy books and games, and accessories nationwide," he said in a news release.
Current Video Game Exchange stores will be converted to this broader format and all stores will operate under the title, 'It's About Games'
Olson said the industry is estimated at about a $3.1 billion retail market and the company sees 1,000 franchised game stores in the future.

Grow Biz develops, franchises and operates stores that buy, sell, trade and consign used and new merchandise. At March 29, 1997, there were 1,158 stores in operation in the United States, Canada, Europe and Australia.
